limits: File stability is checked per capture, not atomically across the source tree.
Credential signatures are heuristic and cannot prove absence of every possible secret.
Filesystem iteration order may vary; gzip bytes and object hashes are deterministic.
Integrity requires a trusted catalog or externally pinned catalog SHA256; this is not a signed archive.

policy.claims: byte preservation and integrity only; no dataset QA, training result or model-gain claim
policy.mirror: README/DATA_CARD, docs/config/scripts/tests/registry_tools/mechanisms, allowed program paths, shallow cycle reports/manifests
policy.omission_rows: blocked directories produce one unenumerated-subtree row, not an inferred count of descendant files
safe_filename_exceptions: CHECK method source outside protected ancestors
policy.scope: root and core foundry trees, cycles/evidence/audits/profiles/reviews/candidates/packets/releases and registry/state metadata, subject to explicit omissions
policy.secret_handling: omit entire occurrence; never redact immutable bytes or print credential values
policy.stability: stat / hash read / stat / compress-and-hash read / stat, with open-file stat checks; matching reads required
